# celenagaia

> > A personal essay blog exploring mental health, eating disorders, recovery, and the craft of writing through intimate memoirs and interviews.

Celena Gaia's WordPress blog features deeply personal essays on anorexia, anorexia athletica, and recovery journeys, alongside literary analysis and writing craft discussions. The site blends memoir, interviews with caregivers, and reflective essays on mental health and creative expression.

## Key Topics

- eating disorders
- anorexia recovery
- mental health
- personal memoir
- carer perspective
- writing craft
- anorexia athletica
- recovery journey
- creative writing
- characterization
- mental health relationships
- carers support
- personal essay
- eating disorder interview
- gym culture

## Eating Disorders & Recovery Memoirs

- [Coping Together: Carers and Eating Disorders](https://celenagaia.wordpress.com/2014/09/01/coping-together-carers-and-eating-disorders): Personal memoir on anorexia diagnosis, family impact, and recovery journey
- [Going the extra mile: Life with Anorexia Athletica](https://celenagaia.wordpress.com/2014/06/23/going-the-extra-mile-life-with-anorexia-athletica): Personal memoir on exercise addiction, anorexia athletica, and psychological recovery

## Caregiver Interviews & Perspectives

- [Full Text: Interview with Jimmi Campkin, "Coping Together: Carers and Eating Disorders."](https://celenagaia.wordpress.com/2014/09/01/full-text-interview-with-jimmi-campkin-coping-together-carers-and-eating-disorder): Interview with Jimmi Campkin on carer perspectives and eating disorder recovery
- [Full text: Interview with Brent Allard, "Coping Together: Carers and Eating Disorders."](https://celenagaia.wordpress.com/2014/09/01/full-text-interview-with-brent-allard-coping-together-carers-and-eating-disorders): Interview with Brent Allard on anorexia caregiving and relationship coping strategies

## Writing Craft & Literary Analysis

- [Gym Etiquette and Sociability: Co-Authored by Christopher Smith](https://celenagaia.wordpress.com/2014/08/18/gym-etiquette-and-sociability-co-authored-by-christopher-smith): Co-authored essay on gym culture, fitness behavior, and social dynamics
